snippet.title: I’m 18 and Starting My Own Game Studio | First Project: Lucky Newt (3D Platformer Reveal & Progress)
snippet.description:
I’m 18 and building my own 3D platformer from scratch — meet Lucky Newt! 

This is my first devlog where I reveal the game, share my progress so far, and talk about the journey of starting my own indie game studio.

About Lucky Newt:

Lucky Newt is a vibrant, story-rich co-op platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over the Small World. Play solo or with a friend in this small world full of luck!

Wishlist the game now on Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3914970/Lucky_Newt/?beta=0

Check out the Kickstarter at: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/iyanda/the-next-big-3d-platformer-has-arrived-its-lucky-newt?ref=acune7&token=7d21c78e

Let’s talk!
